title: Avoid per-message layout snapshot work on every native history scroll frame
outcome: Measure and remove unnecessary per-message getLayoutSnapshot work in useConversationHistoryScroll.measure during native scrolling, especially a fully resident conversation, preserving history reach, geometry and FOLLOW/STAY ownership.
acceptance: A focused diagnostic establishes the scroll-frame work and validates a bounded or aggregate-height approach without per-message work when no missing extent or count change requires it.
Behavioral tests retain missing-history navigation, prefix correction and FOLLOW/STAY authority after the change.
